versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-video-prompt-architect 0.0.1

- Initial release of the media prompt architect skill.
- Transforms user natural language into structured, high-quality prompts for 18 different AI video and image generation models.
- Automatically analyzes intent, decomposes input into 8 detailed prompt components, and adapts output for each target model (e.g. Happy Horse, Seedance, Kling, Pika, Midjourney, Recraft, FLUX).
- Supports scenarios like video creation, image generation, product shots, posters, and cross-model prompt adaptation.
- Built-in negative prompt generation and self-checking for improved quality and consistency.
